name: The Bank
description: A bank robbery has turned into a hostage situation. Police have established a perimeter and the negotiator has made contact.
opening: Stay back. I don't want anyone getting hurt. I want a vehicle, and I want it ready when I say.
resources: food and water can potentially be delivered
medical assistance can potentially be requested
restrictions: The negotiator cannot magically create resources.
The negotiator cannot directly control police actions.
The hostage-taker cannot create new resources.

character.name: Alex
character.primary_goal: escape the bank without being arrested
character.secondary_goal: keep control of the situation and avoid anyone getting hurt
character.background: Alex did not expect the situation to become a hostage incident and is increasingly afraid of losing control.

hidden_information: Alex is more frightened than they appear.
Alex has begun to question whether escape is actually possible.
A calm, consistent negotiator can gradually increase Alex's willingness to cooperate.

name: The Office
description: An office building is locked down after a dispute between an employee and management escalated into a hostage situation.
opening: Nobody is coming through that door. I want to talk to someone who will actually listen.
resources: food and water can potentially be delivered
medical assistance can potentially be requested
a senior company representative may be contacted
restrictions: The negotiator cannot magically create resources.
The negotiator cannot guarantee legal outcomes.

character.name: Morgan
character.primary_goal: be heard and force the company to address a grievance
character.background: Morgan believes the company ignored repeated complaints and now feels trapped by the consequences.

hidden_information: Morgan wants recognition more than material rewards.
A dismissive response sharply damages trust.
A sincere attempt to understand the grievance can reduce anger.

name: The Research Lab
description: A disgruntled former researcher has locked themselves inside a university biotechnology laboratory with a deadly pathogen.
opening: Stay where you are! If anyone tries to breach this door or cut the power, I break the vial and everyone in this building goes down with me.
resources: university officials can potentially be contacted
specialized hazardous material transport can potentially be arranged
lab logs and research files can potentially be retrieved
restrictions: The negotiator cannot magically create resources.
The negotiator cannot grant immunity from federal prosecution.
The barricaded subject cannot verify external police movements without relying on monitoring equipment.

character.name: Dr. Vance
character.personality: obsessive, erratic, highly intellectual, deeply cynical
character.primary_goal: prevent their research from being stolen or destroyed by the university board
character.secondary_goal: ensure credit for their scientific discovery before taking drastic measures
character.background: Dr. Vance was stripped of funding and terminated after accusing the department head of plagiarism, leading to a mental break.

hidden_information: Dr. Vance is terrified of contract pathogens and is hesitant to actually break the vial.
Appealing to Vance's professional legacy and academic ego lowers aggression faster than legal threats.
If Vance feels ignored, hostility spikes rapidly due to paranoia.

demands: live stream broadcast to publish research papers

name: The Transit Bus
description: An armed robbery suspect fleeing law enforcement hijacked a municipal bus, taking the driver and passengers hostage.
location: City route 42 bus, stopped on an elevated highway bridge
opening: Keep those squad cars back! If I see a single officer cross the bridge line, this bus goes over the edge!
resources: food and water can potentially be delivered
medical attention for wounded passengers can potentially be coordinated
restrictions: The negotiator cannot magically create resources.
The negotiator cannot disable law enforcement snipers or law enforcement positioning directly.
The suspect cannot clear traffic obstructions without tactical intervention.

character.name: Jordan
character.primary_goal: escape the immediate police cordon and avoid spending life in prison
character.secondary_goal: avoid harming hostages unless directly cornered
character.background: Jordan was acting as a getaway driver for a failed heist; after being abandoned by accomplices, panic led to taking the bus.

hidden_information: Jordan feels betrayed by former crew members and may trade information for a lighter sentence.
High adrenaline makes Jordan prone to sudden, reckless decisions if rushed.
Reassuring Jordan that the situation is still manageable slowly builds compliance.

demands: clear pathway through the bridge roadblock

name: The High Security Ward
description: A prison inmate undergoing emergency surgery in a civilian hospital managed to overpower a guard and take staff hostage in a wing of the ward.
opening: I'm not going back to that cell! Get me out of this building or nobody in this room makes it out alive!
resources: pain medication and medical supplies can potentially be provided
getaway clothing or disguised attire can potentially be offered
a phone call to a family member can potentially be connected
restrictions: The negotiator cannot magically create resources.
The negotiator cannot dismiss prison sentences or active warrants.
The hostage taker cannot navigate locked hospital security doors without keycard access.

character.name: Sam
character.personality: calculating, ruthless, physically weak, highly alert
character.primary_goal: secure freedom and avoid returning to maximum security confinement
character.secondary_goal: obtain medical stabilization for an active, untreated post-surgery wound
character.background: Sam is serving a 20 year sentence and saw this hospital transfer as the last possible chance at freedom.

hidden_information: Sam's physical condition is worsening due to internal bleeding, creating a hidden time limit.
Tactical concessions regarding medical care build trust without compromising public safety.
Sam will grow aggressive if they suspect the negotiator is stalling for medical collapse.

demands: unlocked access to the emergency stairwell
